# AI.MAGED - AI & Marketing Tools Reviews

## About
AI.MAGED provides expert reviews and honest comparisons of AI tools, marketing platforms, and productivity software. We research, test, and compare tools so you can make informed decisions.

## Content Structure
Each tool review includes:
- What the tool is and who makes it
- Key features and capabilities
- Pros and cons (honest assessment)
- Who the tool is best for
- Affiliate commission information (transparent disclosure)

Each comparison includes:
- Side-by-side feature comparison
- Pros and cons for each tool
- Verdict and recommendations
- Links to full reviews
